correctness.rationale: The exact factorization follows from k independent interior three-clock minima plus independent exterior endpoint-vacancy processes; all index and boundary conditions were verified using 71 exhaustive finite probability assertions. No finite computation is used to establish an infinite theorem.

value.rationale: The longest cluster of consecutive overlapping length-three augmenting opportunities in random greedy matchings is a natural, algorithmically meaningful robustness/repair statistic. Exact finite all-order probabilities and an asymptotic rare-cluster extremal correction answer an unsolved-looking spatial aggregation question not determined by the classical vacancy density or a two-point probability. The lattice correction and geometric cluster survival indicate nontrivial local dependence rather than a routine isolated moment.
